column-configurator.purpose: Let users show, hide, reorder, and persist table columns without breaking scanability, exports, or saved views.
useWhen: A dense desktop table has optional columns.
Users need to adapt a table to role, process, or saved view.
Column changes affect export, persistence, or dashboard modules.
doNotUseWithoutReview: The table has only a few fixed columns.
Required columns, export rules, or saved-view ownership are unclear.
Reordering would hide compliance, financial, or identity context.
foundations: Defines panel width, checklist density, table preview, and responsive overflow.
Owns column labels, required-column copy, reset copy, and saved-view language.
Controls selected columns, required state, focus, and disabled treatment.
Default, dirty, applied, required, disabled, loading, and error states are explicit.
Column controls can appear in Menu, Dialog, or Drawer without replacing the Table component.
Column toggles, required columns, order, count, reset, and apply are keyboard reachable.
slots: Preview or target table using package Table.
Column visibility controls with required column handling.
Apply, reset, save view, or cancel.
Dirty count, saved state, or invalid configuration feedback.
variants: Users can show/hide optional columns while required columns remain protected.
Applied columns can persist as a named view.
Default columns can be restored without losing table data.
motion: Preview updates after user action without changing focus unexpectedly.
Count and apply state update instantly.
Menu/Dialog/Drawer uses Design System overlay motion and reduced-motion fallback.
accessibility: Every column control has a visible or programmatic label.
Required columns cannot be hidden silently.
Keyboard users can apply and reset without losing table context.
tests: Optional column can be hidden and restored.
Apply updates table preview and count.

canDecide: Use Column Configurator when a table has optional columns and persistence rules.
Keep required identity or compliance columns protected.
Use package Table for the visible table.
mustAsk: Required columns, export behavior, saved-view scope, or persistence policy is unclear.
Columns expose financial, identity, compliance, or regulated information.
rejectIf: The table is not using Design System Table.
miel.handoff: Confirm required columns, optional columns, default view, persistence, export impact, saved views, and reset behavior.
